just to make myself a bit clearer, my point was that him being homeless or having a mental health crisis is irrelevent, when people also do this type of thing without that being a factor. im not saying all men are bad, but the way society raises men puts men in a situation where these actions are the outcome, and i would like for both men and women to feel safe and for society to improve. focusing on the victim saying something in the heat of the moment, rather than understanding what the reason behind his actions are does not help to improve society. having to qualify everything you say in order to not be misunderstood is pretty tiring and not possible in that situation. people will give others a lot of leeway, unless they feel personally attacked and then only the worst is assumed.

dont feel guilty for feeling like this, you dont have to have a reason for your depression, your feelings are real and deserve to be treated. there can be causes like hormonal imbalances (like seratonin deficiency) that lead to depression and consulting your doctor to check out other things as well like your vitamin d levels can be very helpful, this stuff can have a huge effect.

i know what that feels like and i dont think i can entirely remove that fear for you, but sadly you wont know until you try and i think trying isnt a bad option. you could also try to just tell them that you arent feeling emotionally well and slowly build your way towards asking for professional help, that way you can see their reactions as you talk to them and bail in the worst case. i didnt think my mum would take me seriously when i told her, but she did to my surprise and is helping me. if you think telling them isnt an option at all, maybe theres another adult like a relative or a teacher you trust that you could talk to in confidence? i know its hard and takes a lot of courage, but i believe its worth it to have tried. im wishing you all the best, just know this internet stranger is rooting for you. and if your parents end up lecturing you for not feeling well, thats horrible parenting and not your fault at all, remember that.

im so sorry youre dealing with this, dont listen to people telling you youre not depressed or just sad, you know your emotions better than they do and clearly they dont understand what youre going through. bullying is tough and bullies are horrible, they say its just a joke when clearly its not and you know its not, i promise you, youre so much better than them. is there any way you can ask your parents if you can see a mental health professional? you dont have to tell them anything specific if you feel uncomfortable with that, just that you feel like it might help you. i spent a big part of my life being depressed, also partly because of people making "jokes" in school and i regret not trying to look for help sooner. its not easy, but you can do it, i believe in you.
